description: Source code implementing a traverser for nameless uniform buffer variables in the ANGLE graphics project, including logic to assign internal names and replace references within shader code.

classes.name: NameUniformBufferVariablesTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses shader AST nodes to assign internal names to nameless uniform buffer variables and replace references with indexed access.

methods.name: visitDeclaration
methods.description: Visits uniform buffer declarations, assigns internal names to nameless buffers, and updates internal mappings.

methods.name: visitSymbol
methods.description: Replaces references to fields of nameless uniform buffers with indexed access nodes.
